summary: Pinned three-record sample has equal mix weights, missing parametric prototypes, and 21/21 fresh Racket/mirror agreements with seven distinct inputs per record. Retained teaching evidence differs by family. Proposes an explicitly estimated 120-case structural-coverage allocation and bounded comparison; preserves the 10% evaluation focus, weights and approval/admission boundaries.

selection.method: pinned anchor plus Random(int(seed,16)).sample(sorted(all_ids minus anchor),2); no reroll

representation.scope: Three sampled records only; no external-source ranking or full-library census.
representation.arc_gen_or_re_arc_identification: Neither provenance is explicitly tagged in inspected selected metadata; no source-level comparison is possible.

retained_evidence_scope: Current source-bound notes/index were inspected. Prior linter, grammar, override, repair and census claims remain reviewer-reported; this probe does not upgrade them.

comparison.alternative_sampling: Enumerate each of 44 branch-visible mirror masks once at an explicit foreground color; use independently seeded defaults for other records.
comparison.quality_proxy: Distinct normalized mirror structures only; not measured downstream learning quality.
assumptions: Independent default mirror draws: 42 interior mask probabilities 1/43, two endpoint probabilities 1/86 from rounded uniform draw.
Tiny single-process hot timings extrapolated linearly; not stable performance benchmarks.
Equal number of inspected inputs is only a review-budget proxy; actual review minutes differ and were not measured.
Enumerated fixed-color masks require a separate color-transfer check.

metrics: accepted distinct four-query lessons per review minute and reference second
proposed_experiment.structural_saturation: stop further draws and report saturation

predeclared_grouping.shuffle: deterministic per-family slot shuffle independent of outputs
predeclared_grouping.input_reuse: No deliberate input reuse or duplicate-slot resampling; within-lesson duplicates fail the distinct-pair contract, across-lesson duplicates reported separately.
predeclared_grouping.remainder_counting: Coverage and cost only; never accepted-lesson numerator.

unknown_or_not_run: No new parameter variants or variant approval.
No native configurable episode API or broad four-query identifiability established for all three tasks.
No fresh linter/grammar gate, battery, large census, model job or measured repair duration.
No direct ARC-GEN/RE-ARC comparison: neither selected.
No estimate of rare rejection probability from 21 successful samples.
No data-mix denominator or deployed training allocation measured.
stopping_reason: One bounded targeted probe completed; sufficient source-bound evidence for a proposal, with unmeasured quality/cost and source-coverage gaps explicitly retained.

peer_review.basis: read-only review of existing probe_result.json and assessment.md; no additional execution
refinements_applied: Distinguish zero failed returned samples from unmeasured internal retries.
Predeclare equal candidate-lesson counts, demo/query grouping, input reuse and remainder handling.
